links.outcome: Participants' ability to distinguish AI-enhanced from real post-treatment orthodontic images
links.effect: 63.2% misclassified AI-enhanced images as real; 18.5% misclassified real images as AI-generated; higher trust in AI content increased odds of misclassification (OR 1.38).
links.quote: A total of 63.2% of participants misclassified AI-enhanced images as real, whereas 18.5% misclassified real images as AI-generated.

screen.reason: Empirical survey evaluating lay perception and misclassification of generative AI (ChatGPT with DALL-E 3) smile simulations compared to real clinical outcomes, finding that participants frequently mistake AI images for real outcomes.
